notes: Every item in contact sheets table_01.jpg through table_07.jpg was visually inspected with the original green annotation box; 27 originals were additionally inspected at full image size.

Conservative visual screening is not an independent human ground-truth certification. Ambiguous cropped extra furniture is quarantined rather than automatically assigned pseudo-labels. No source labels were edited.

table_red_desk_room contains T001-T016, T018-T023 and T194-T199: the same red two-drawer desk and white glossy marble-tile floor with black skirting. The series crosses the original train/valid split. This is also the Table scene to compare against Chair captures in the same white-floor/black-skirting environment; per-object group_id is retained for traceability.

table_beige_desk_room contains T100-T109, T111-T116, T118-T123 and T125-T131: same beige three-drawer desk, yellow-brown floor tiles and pale tile skirting. This is visually a different environment from the red desk. A cabinet, fan, cables or a small fabric edge alone were not treated as missing target annotations.

table_plaid_covered_curved_legs connects T032, T070, T094 and T186, including original train/valid images. The original T032 inspection supports a cloth-covered table; none shows an additional clear target.

Repeated product groups link matching products or photo variants: orange computer desk T037/T145; natural wood dining product T061/T072; antique yellow-background table T134/T154; antique wall console T166/T171; oak drawer table T167/T180.

table_honey_drawer_product_family conservatively keeps closely matching honey-coloured panel-top single-drawer table product variants T146/T147/T149/T151/T162/T176 together; exact same physical instance is not established for every product-photo variant.

Some accepted product images are low resolution or blurred but still show one identifiable table and an encompassing box. Acceptance is for a small PoC subset, not a claim of production-grade image quality.
No new numerical boxes or class labels were invented. Quarantine reasons distinguish definite missing targets from unresolved cropped-furniture ambiguity.
